title: Danish Magnates
capsule: In this 1333–1352 window this entity denotes the Danish-held Duchy of Estonia (Harrien and Wierland, i.e. Harjumaa and Virumaa), governed not by a resident king but by the local Danish nobility and royal vassals, especially during the 1332–1340 Danish interregnum when the throne itself stood vacant. This arrangement ended when King Valdemar IV sold the duchy to the Teutonic Order in 1346, after the St. George's Night Uprising.
